Diagnostic.description:
A warning, error or translation notice about a query, with a half-open code-point span into `q`.
`reading` is only ever set on `WARN_MIXED_AND_OR`, so a client never parses `message` for it.

reading.description: Only ever set on `WARN_MIXED_AND_OR`: the text at `span` as it was read, each `AND` group in parentheses and the branches joined with ` OR ` (`a b OR c` → `(a b) OR c`). Replacing `span` in `q` with it gives a query with the same canonical form whose level no longer mixes `AND` and `OR`. Never shortened, unlike the reading quoted in `message`. Null on every other code, and on a `WARN_MIXED_AND_OR` that has none to offer: the "… and N more" summary, or a level that has errors (its `message` then quotes the level as typed, not a reading).
reading.title: Reading

(the index's other two inputs, so a drifted replay can name a method change after the pinned index is
gone). `ids` is None when the caller didn't ask for them.

Body version 2 adds `sources` (the snapshot manifest's source names, sorted), `identification_citable`
(false when every source is a bootstrap one, `vocab.bootstrap_only`: the corpus is an earlier search's
output, so `total` is not a PRISMA identification number) and `crawl_dates_kind` (per `crawl_dates` key:
`crawl`, `scholar_query_dates` or `mixed`), and `dedup`'s two other not-merged counts. A v1 body has
none of them: they read as None ("not recorded"), never as a guess.

get.description:
Every record the query matches, in `format`: of `q` (with `mode`, default `native`) on the pinned
`index_version` (else the served index), or the stored ids of search record `record_id` (alone) from the
index it names. Never paginated or truncated; `X-Total` equals `/search`'s `total` for the same query and
index (for a record, its stored `total`). Each record names its abstract's source (decision-018), from the
exported index's snapshot; for a pinned index whose snapshot this instance can't verify, the same records
with every abstract withheld and `X-Abstract-Source: unavailable` (decision-021).

get.description:
The stored record and a replay of it now (HTTP 200 whatever the status). `ids` is null unless
`include=ids`; `/export?record_id=` streams the papers themselves. With `replay=false`, the stored record
alone (`replay` null; the top-level versions are the served index's).

parameters.description: A search record id: 12 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 - _`. Any other shape is 422 `API_BAD_PARAM`.
parameters.name: id

schema.description: A search record id: 12 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 - _`. Any other shape is 422 `API_BAD_PARAM`.
schema.title: Id

parameters.description: `ids` to include the record's sorted id list.
parameters.name: include

schema.description: `ids` to include the record's sorted id list.
schema.title: Include

parameters.description: `false` to read the stored record without replaying it (TASK-091): `replay` is then null, nothing is run, so it is answered while verification is busy. Without `include=ids` it costs one token, not the export weight; returning the full membership list costs the export weight. Default `true`: the record and a replay check.
parameters.name: replay

schema.description: `false` to read the stored record without replaying it (TASK-091): `replay` is then null, nothing is run, so it is answered while verification is busy. Without `include=ids` it costs one token, not the export weight; returning the full membership list costs the export weight. Default `true`: the record and a replay check.
schema.title: Replay

get.description:
The ids a replay now adds and removes, with titles, and which `index_version` inputs changed. Each
list is paged by `offset`/`limit` (≤ 200, never clamped); `added_total`/`removed_total` are in full. A
title comes from the index the replay ran on, null if it doesn't hold the paper. A refused replay
compared nothing: empty lists, null totals.

parameters.description: A search record id: 12 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 - _`. Any other shape is 422 `API_BAD_PARAM`.
parameters.name: id

schema.description: A search record id: 12 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 - _`. Any other shape is 422 `API_BAD_PARAM`.
schema.title: Id

parameters.description: Entries of each list (`added`, `removed`) to skip. Past the end is an empty list.
parameters.name: offset

schema.description: Entries of each list (`added`, `removed`) to skip. Past the end is an empty list.
schema.title: Offset

parameters.description: Entries of each list per page, 0 to 200. Over 200 is 422 `API_BAD_PARAM`, never clamped.
parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Entries of each list per page, 0 to 200. Over 200 is 422 `API_BAD_PARAM`, never clamped.
schema.title: Limit

get.description:
One page of the ranked matched set, with its total, exclusion accounting, disjunctive facets and
highlights. `limit` over 200 is a 422 (never clamped); a query that doesn't parse is a 422 with its
diagnostics.

parameters.description: The query (spec 02 grammar). At most 2,000 Unicode code points: a longer one is 422 `PARSE_TOO_LONG`, refused before it is parsed; so is one whose canonical form (defaults written out) is longer, refused after canonicalising.
parameters.name: q

schema.description: The query (spec 02 grammar). At most 2,000 Unicode code points: a longer one is 422 `PARSE_TOO_LONG`, refused before it is parsed; so is one whose canonical form (defaults written out) is longer, refused after canonicalising.
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: `native` (this grammar) or `scholar` (Google Scholar / Publish or Perish syntax, translated).
parameters.name: mode

schema.description: `native` (this grammar) or `scholar` (Google Scholar / Publish or Perish syntax, translated).
schema.title: Mode

parameters.description: The order of `hits`. Never changes `total` or membership (guarantee 5).
parameters.name: sort

schema.description: The order of `hits`. Never changes `total` or membership (guarantee 5).
schema.title: Sort

parameters.description: Hits to skip. Past the end is an empty page, not an error.
parameters.name: offset

schema.description: Hits to skip. Past the end is an empty page, not an error.
schema.title: Offset

parameters.description: Hits per page, 0 to 200. Over 200 is 422 `API_BAD_PARAM`, never clamped.
parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Hits per page, 0 to 200. Over 200 is 422 `API_BAD_PARAM`, never clamped.
schema.title: Limit
